response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile, senior full-stack engineer with broad experience across web, mobile, and embedded systems, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: minimal recent hands-on C++ (a brief stint in 2014-2015 with C/C++ components for an IDE), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure whatsoever. His career has focused on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and general web/product engineering rather than financial systems.
strengths: Strong senior-level engineering craftsmanship with TDD, CI/CD, and software architecture experience
Demonstrated versatility across multiple languages and platforms (web, mobile, embedded)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: Only ~6 months of C++ experience (2014-2015), far short of the 5-10 years required
No evidence of Windows platform development; recent work is Linux/cloud/Node-based
No fixed income, capital markets, investment banking, or Summit platform experience

key_factors.factor: Insufficient C++ experience depth and recency
No capital markets/fixed income/investment banking domain exposure
No Windows or SQL Server/Oracle experience evident
